body:
Panache — RTS Belle Époque pour mobile

Well this is delightful: I released Battle Drones yesterday under an Apache 2.0 License and there's already a French language fork by Gabriel Turpin which reskins the game to take place in steampunk 1900s France and adds an animated intro!

Panache est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel pour mobile et navigateur, dans la France de la Belle Époque (vers 1900) : dirigeables, Fardiers à vapeur, Creusot cuirassés, automates en képi, Gargantua la forteresse marchante — et beaucoup de panache.

You can play Panache here - it's worth clicking that link just to experience the new intro video.

So far it's mostly just aesthetic updates as opposed to gameplay changes. The music has had a French twist added to it as well.

The new steampunk models are so cool!

Here's a page with the original Battle Drones models and that same page with the new Panache alternatives .

This is a comparison of the original and the new design for the Goliath:

Tags: game-design , open-source

images.alt: The new buildings are gold and red, there are dirigibles and biplanes, and the Goliath stomping mech has had a total makeover.
On the left: blue stomping mech robot, missile launcher shoulders, classic sci-fi robot look. On the right: gold, steampunk, much more 1900s French look.

summaryZh: Panache — RTS Belle Époque pour mobile。嗯，这太令人高兴了：我昨天在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布了 Battle Drones，并且已经有 Gabriel Turpin 的法语分支，它重新设计了游戏，使其发生在 1900 年代的法国蒸汽朋克，并添加了动画介绍！ Panache 是一款适用于手机和浏览器的实时战略游戏，背景设定在美好时代的法国（1900 年左右）：飞艇、蒸汽驱动的 Fardiers、Creusot 战列舰、kepis 机器人、步行堡垒 Gargantua
